headline: Names a US Postal Service building in Tyrone, New York, after Specialist Christopher Scott.
what_it_does: This law renames a post office building at 815 County Road 23 in Tyrone, New York, as the "Specialist Christopher Scott Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, fees, or how the building operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on August 8, 2014, and the renaming took effect on that date.
